requirements.title: Add a product
requirements.text: A POST /products with a name and a price adds the product to the catalog, returns its generated id, and stores the price it was given. A request with no name is rejected (negative path).

strictnessLadder.description: the product is in the in-memory catalog

requirements.title: List the catalog
requirements.text: GET /products returns every product that has been added, in the order they were added, each with its current price.

requirements.title: Reprice a product
requirements.text: PATCH /products/:id changes a product’s name or its price and returns the updated product. A repriced product must report its new price on the next read. A reprice to a price that is not a positive number is rejected (negative path).

requirements.title: Remove a discontinued product
requirements.text: DELETE /products/:id removes the product so it no longer appears in the catalog. Removal should be confirmable from an independent read of the list, not only from the response to the delete itself.

strictnessLadder.description: a browser viewing the catalog confirms it is gone

requirements.title: Search the catalog
requirements.text: Shoppers should be able to find a product by name without paging through the whole catalog. Not yet implemented or tested.

strictnessLadder.description: the catalog is filtered by name
